stop_rules.dev_main_truth_drift: stop if Dev origin/main no longer equals authorized source commit
stop_rules.public_origin_main_drift: stop if public start/base HEAD differs from owner-authorized baseline
stop_rules.release_config_conflict: stop if requested files require config semantics not covered by allowlist/denylist
stop_rules.raw_dev_evidence_leakage: stop on any raw Dev artifacts/governance or package-preflight content in projection diff
stop_rules.local_path_leakage: stop on unexpected home-directory absolute path or temp path leakage outside explicit repo-truth record
stop_rules.credential_leakage: stop on credential-looking content or credential files
stop_rules.package_gate_failure: stop before commit if package gates fail for package mutations
stop_rules.owner_missing: stop if execution mutation category, target files, or downstream scope lacks exact owner authorization
